Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the supplied Theme D screenshot into a NEW sibling design direction called "D — Quiet guide". It is the same real equipment-evidence product and workflow, redesigned to feel warm, approachable and calm rather than industrial or corporate. Do not keep the old bright-blue dashboard treatment. Produce one high-resolution wide flat desktop application screenshot, no device frame, no marketing composition, no explanatory annotation rail.
DESIGN SYSTEM shared on every screen: warm paper background #F6F3EC, near-black warm graphite text #30352F, muted olive primary actions #59684D, pale sage selection #E3E8DD, warm ochre unresolved text #8E642C, chalk-white form surfaces. Flat colors; no gradients, glows, glass, dark mode, floating elements or decorative shadows. Friendly moderate-size Georgia-like serif page title, readable humanist sans-serif body, neither Inter nor Roboto/geometric font. Small 4px control corners, thin warm-grey dividers, open editorial grouping. No uniform rounded card grids, KPI cards, giant badges, fake charts, decorative stats or stock illustrations. Use deliberate uneven whitespace: main task prominent, secondary context quiet. Concise task-specific copy, no buzzwords. Product title Capital Integrity is small, with "Plant A · Prepared trial" context and read-only "Analyst" identity (no role-switch permissions). Synthetic demonstration evidence only.
SHARED SHELL: header is slender. Four functional destinations Overview, Evidence, Site inspection, Assessment in a collapsible left navigation rail only 64–76px wide in its default collapsed state; show an "Expand ›" handle. No permanently open left task queue. The right evidence/context sidebar is CLOSED, accessible through a quiet "Details ‹" edge handle. At most two main working columns, not three sidebars. No large top multi-stage cockpit strip.
BOTTOM DOCK: a minimal fixed shallow tray with compact chevron/arrow tabs "⌃ Activity", "⌃ Requests", "⌃ History". It is collapsed by default: only the tab strip visible, no recent-activity table. Only one tab can expand at a time. Include one small "‹ Back" and one relevant primary next-action button above/right of the dock, not four competing primary buttons. These are purposeful navigation controls, not decorative arrow graphics.
PROGRESSIVE DISCLOSURE: within the active task show one numbered section open. Earlier saved sections are short collapsed summary rows with Edit; later sections are short muted rows with lock icon and a plain reason. Save current required inputs unlocks the next section. Completed sections can reopen. "Unknown" / "Needs clarification" with a reason is a valid saved response, never require all claims supported to advance. Read-only existing reports remain accessible. Keep computed vs reviewed results, accepted vs extracted evidence, and immutable original evidence distinct. No automatic photo-condition inference or financial underwriting. Use uploaded imagery only where directly relevant, not as decoration.
Maintain the same controls, typography, palette, navigation and bottom-tray behavior across all four screen variants. The actual frontend is not being built in this image; this is a refined visual concept.
SCREEN 01: Overview.
OVERVIEW. Use the exact page title "A clear view of Plant A". A small supporting sentence "Three machines. Check the gaps, then review the evidence." Keep the central useful six-claim matrix as a horizontal-scroll table, not a big analytic dashboard. Show inline text "3 machines · 18 claims · 3 need clarification" instead of KPI cards. First column Machine is sticky and identifiable, with CNC-001 Operating, CNC-002 Operating, CNC-003 Packaged. Columns Identity, Purchase, Payment, Presence, Installation, Commissioning with authentic original trial results: machine 1 all supported, machine 2 commissioning unresolved only, machine 3 installation and commissioning unresolved. To communicate overflow, keep first columns visible and rightmost commissioning partially offscreen inside table container; show an actual horizontal scrollbar and unobtrusive left/right arrow controls with "More columns →". Do not squash all text to fit. Below table one open calm work item "CNC-002 · Commissioning" with text "Certificate not yet accepted" and a text link "See what is missing". Three compact disclosure rows: "1 Choose a machine — CNC-002 saved" collapsed completed; "2 Review its evidence" current open with short single explanation and one main button "Review CNC-002 evidence →"; "3 Review the finding" locked with helper "Save the evidence review first". Keep Activity/Requests/History bottom tray entirely collapsed. Right Details drawer closed. No multi-card visual dashboard.
images.refinement_prompt: Make precise refinements to this existing calm interface. Keep its warm paper/olive style and all existing layout/content except these changes. Remove the green duplicate "Review CNC-002 evidence" button INSIDE step 2; replace it with quiet explanatory text "Next: confirm or flag the extracted fields." Keep ONLY the bottom-right primary button. In the claim-table viewport, show Machine, Identity, Purchase, Payment, Presence and the beginning of Installation; Commissioning must be offscreen to the right. Keep readable column widths and the existing horizontal scrollbar/arrows so horizontal scrolling is meaningful instead of fitting all columns and pretending overflow. Keep overview counts 3 machines / 18 claims / 3 need clarification. Do not change anything else.
images.data_correction_prompt: Make one precise data-label correction in this existing warm overview mockup. In the claim table, the CNC-003 row under the Presence column is currently blank. Fill that one cell with the same green checkmark and word "Supported" used in the other supported cells. Preserve the entire remaining layout, all other cells, counts, warm colors, typography, single primary button, collapsed tabs and horizontal scrolling cue unchanged.
